note: College shop-vs-sharp screen (output/research/cfb/shop_screen.json, rules pre-declared and committed before results in f33671d). Passing rules on 2021-25 with the all-Arizona book set: spreads EV>=4% (113 bets, CLV +3.8% vs the Pinnacle close, p 3e-10, 5/5 seasons, ROI +0.1% +- 9.1%), totals EV>=2% (914 bets, CLV +2.0%, p 4e-13, 5/5, ROI +0.3% +- 3.2%), moneyline EV>=2% (403 bets, CLV +2.9%, p 2e-11, 5/5, ROI +2.6% +- 6.0%). Every one of the 12 declared rules had positive CLV; 7 failed only on realized ROI (noise) or bet count. Edge largest 3-7 days before kickoff. Pricing uses the key-number distributions in cfb_dist.json (fit 2014-21). Live snapshots are hourly Thu-Sat and every 3 h otherwise (research had ~2 per weekday), so more bets per game window are expected. The moneyline part overlaps the cfb_ml track (that one uses only your three books). Do not edit to fit results; bump the version.

qualify.one_bet_per_game_per_market: first qualifying snapshot, best EV across books and sides at that snapshot

sizing.method: quarter Kelly vs the Pinnacle fair price, capped

grading.clv: EV of our bet (same number and price) under Pinnacle's last pre-kickoff quote of that market, key-number pricing
grading.result: CFBD final score; pushes return the stake
